english.meaning: to be willing to bother with something tedious
english.note: Seen in 你制唔制, would you put up with it. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: You want to buy a phone like this and then go home and read through all those manuals?
exampleSentences.traditional: 買個噉嘅電話，跟住返來要刨咁多說明書，你制唔制？
